items.title: Benny Golson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I know that when I interviewed Al McKibbon, he talked about rooming with Chano [Pozo], touring with Diz’s band.

ctx.x: Um-hmm. Not in New York. Traveling with Dizzy’s band. It was always two to a room. Now it’s one to a room. But it was two to a room then. That two to a room, we got to – I can’t talk about that. Quincy Jones. My man.
I know that when I interviewed Al McKibbon, he talked about rooming with Chano [Pozo], touring with Diz’s band. So there’s a long history and legacy with two . . .
. . . with the two beds. One wants to do something – yeah. Those were good days though.
